verdict.rationale: Reclaim's first-party docs describe Scheduling Links that let you send links to your availability so others can book time across one or many calendars. Bookings draw on your true, synced availability across calendars, and Reclaim can offer lower-priority smart events as open slots, auto-rescheduling whatever gets overbooked. That covers the core of self-serve booking without back-and-forth email. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the booking-link flow, and no detailed docs on the invitee-side experience of picking a time.
